result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure, including marked zebra crosswalks and stop-sign control for cross-traffic. However, the environment lacks physical buffers between the narrow sidewalks and the roadway, and the pavement shows signs of significant wear and cracking.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven roadway surface near the pedestrian crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: Sidewalks are directly adjacent to the travel lanes without any planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh and upgrade crosswalk markings to high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' styles.

interventions.title: Green Infrastructure Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the walking environment.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a continuous concrete sidewalk separated from the roadway by a narrow grass buffer and a curb. A large, blank brick wall dominates the street frontage, creating a lack of active surveillance and visual interest for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large windowless brick wall reduces natural surveillance and creates a monotonous environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible in the immediate vicinity, which may impact safety and security after dark.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the grass buffer would provide shade, improve aesthetics, and create a stronger physical barrier between the sidewalk and traffic.

interventions.title: Facade Activation
interventions.description: Encourage a mural or green wall on the blank brick facade to improve the visual quality of the pedestrian environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, characterized by narrow, degraded sidewalks and a complete lack of formal crossing infrastructure. The street is dominated by industrial land uses and large parked commercial vehicles that significantly obstruct sightlines for all road users.

hazards.name: Narrow and Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and partially obstructed by overgrown vegetation, forcing pedestrians closer to the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles, including a box truck and a pickup, block visibility between pedestrians and moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street where vehicles are parked

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to meet ADA standards (minimum 5ft width) and clear encroaching vegetation to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to provide designated crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the roadway without a buffer. The environment lacks basic pedestrian amenities such as street lighting, trees, or traffic calming measures, though the low-density residential nature suggests lower traffic volumes.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street light poles, which reduces pedestrian visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

hazards.name: Vegetation Encroachment
hazards.description: Overgrown weeds and grass from adjacent properties are encroaching onto the narrow sidewalk, further reducing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the sidewalk in front of the wooden fence

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow and directly abuts the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security after dark.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a small planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Remove encroaching vegetation and repair minor cracks to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable.
